digest.component_or_area: nginx edge routing / OAuth resource server metadata
propositions: The MCP 401 challenge advertises a resource_metadata URL (/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp) that returns 404 at the nginx edge instead of being routed to the app.
The MCP application already serves the metadata document with 200 on port 8091, but the nginx config lacks a location block to route the path to the app.
The advertised path does not match any nginx location rule in rebar.conf.template and falls through to the Gerrit proxy (127.0.0.1:8080), causing the 404.
An exact-match location block (location = /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp) must be added to the nginx 443 server block with proxy_pass http://rebar_mcp; to preserve the advertised URI.
The fix must not shadow the existing /.well-known/acme-challenge/ location used by certbot.
